purpose: Compile bounded loops, conditions and numeric expressions into explicit UC procedural-3D primitives, then publish and re-verify the resulting deterministic GLB asset.

properties.path: target .glb file outside the protected live machine body
properties.recipe: closed axm.shape-recipe/v0.1 body with named numeric variables, nested repeat/body nodes, conditions, expressions and primitive parts

contains: canonical recipe digest and exact pinned design-donor provenance
declared and effective budgets plus visited/generated counts
exact GLB digest and pre/post-publication geometry validation
explicit unobserved render and host-import boundaries

relationships: turns named numbers into deterministic families of explicit primitive scenes
uses the existing procedural-3D publisher rather than introducing a second mesh renderer
keeps unsupported shapes and rotation on typed HOLD instead of silently approximating them
adapts the bounded recipe-flow concept from a pinned MorphTile snapshot without embedding the MorphTile runtime
limitations: The current receiver supports box, cylinder and pyramid only; unsupported MorphTile primitives remain HOLD instead of being approximated.
The current procedural-3D primitive contract has no rotation field, so any nonzero recipe rotation remains HOLD.
The receiver limits generated scenes to 128 primitives even though the structural recipe walker may inspect up to 4000 nodes.
Compilation and decoded GLB validation do not prove rendered appearance, aesthetic quality, collision, physics, animation or host-engine compatibility.
This is a UC-native implementation of the pinned recipe-flow behavior; it does not bundle, call or redistribute the MorphTile engine.

truth.basis: Recipe identity, donor provenance, expansion budgets, exact expanded specification, GLB bytes and unobserved qualities remain explicit.

agency.basis: The caller owns every variable, expression, part, material, output path and replacement choice; compilation does not select or install itself.

continuity.basis: The existing atomic procedural-3D publication and rollback path remains authoritative, while the original recipe and its digest stay available in the receipt.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Depth, node visits, output count, expression grammar and receiver features are bounded; unsupported or excessive work holds before publication.
